text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Did something good happen 
today?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As you know, I am Aston Machan, the Machan 
who dreams of becoming the world's number 
one mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Dictionary said so. A "mascot" is "an 
auspicious presence that brings good 
fortune"—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So anyway, Trainer. Did something good 
happen today?
